_meta.what: A CAMPAIGN-SCOPED view of the served gacha set: the evergreen STANDARD banners plus ONE campaign period. A selection over existing sources -- no data is created here.
_meta.serve: GACHA_CAMPAIGN=<key> in capture_server (e.g. GACHA_CAMPAIGN=2019-07); unset = serve everything.
_meta.dates: [Community] the Fandom wiki's `community.release` per banner; the served schedule window stays evergreen, so a campaign is a SELECTION and not a time gate.
_meta.tab: the tab column is the RECOVERED classifier (`gacha_banner_types.md` §2) applied to `GachaMst.type`; the type-code table itself is a server encoding (`GACHA_TYPE_CODE`).
_meta.standard: curated (authored) banners + the lowest served id for each evergreen shipped name (Standard Summon, Rare Summon, Featured Summon, Free Lapis Daily Summon, Free Daily 3 Summon, Tutorial Summon).
